title: Add per-row exception isolation to every EntityMerger except LearnerProfileMerger
why: LearnerProfileMerger wraps each row's merge body in try/catch with an explicit rationale (learner_profile_merger.dart:35-37): 'a single malformed/FK-violating profile row must never abort the whole page... The per-row merger try/catch is the primary guard' — a claim echoed verbatim at the sync_orchestrator.dart call site. None of the other 16 merge implementations apply that pattern: any exception thrown while processing row 5 of a 200-row page (an FK violation — see the companion finding on stage_definition/settings/goal — or any malformed-field cast) propagates out of merge() and aborts the whole page. sync_orchestrator.dart's outer per-step catch keeps the app from crashing (it logs 'sync_pull_step_db_error_nonfatal' and returns), but the other 199 rows in that page are silently deferred to the next full sync instead of 199/200 succeeding immediately.
recommendation: Generalize LearnerProfileMerger's per-row try/catch (log via AppLogger, continue to the next row) to the other 16 EntityMerger implementations, or centralize the isolation once inside MergeRouter.dispatch if it's restructured to iterate rows itself.
acceptance_criteria: A fault-injection test (parametrized over EntityKind.all where practical) merges a page containing one deliberately-malformed/throwing row alongside a valid row and asserts the valid row still applies and the bad one is logged, not that the whole page is dropped.
